entities.name: Birth of the Republic and Economic Miracle
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Birth of the Republic and Economic Miracle, a transformative movement in Italy (1946–1968). Emerged from Italian Republic and Fall of Mussolini; Italy signs armistice with the Allies. Catalyzed Red Brigades kidnap and murder former PM Aldo Moro.
